'''Life from Lifelessness''' is the 4th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 11 June 2010. The set consists of 54 cards. This set is part of the ''Life from Lifelessness'' block consisting of cards from [[Life From Lifelessness]], [[Straight and Steady (expansion)|Straight and Steady]], [[BaH! (expansion)|BaH!]], [[Shades of Gray (expansion)|Shades of Gray]], and [[Resistance Is Futile]] virtual expansions.

*1 [[:Category:Artifact (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Artifact]]
*10 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]

*3 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*3 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]

*27 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (1 Bajoran, 1 Borg, 2 Cardassian, 2 Dominion, 5 Federation, 2 Ferengi, 1 Hirogen, 1 Kazon, 2 Klingon, 1 Neutral, 7 Non-Aligned, 2 Romulan, 1 Starfleet and 1 Vidiian)
*3 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian, 1 Non-Aligned and 1 Starfleet)
*1 [[:Category:Tactic (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Tactic]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
